notes.content: HTML elements form the building blocks of web pages. Remember to use semantic tags for better accessibility and SEO.
Java loops: for, while, and do-while. Each has its specific use case. For loops are best for known iterations, while loops for unknown iterations.
Python syntax is beginner-friendly with its indentation-based structure. Practice daily to build muscle memory for common patterns.
C++ memory management: Always pair new with delete, use smart pointers when possible. RAII principle is crucial for resource management.
React hooks revolutionized functional components. useState for state, useEffect for side effects, useMemo for optimization.
Learning programming is like learning a new language. Start with basics, practice regularly, and don't be afraid to make mistakes.
Today I struggled with understanding pointers in C++, but after drawing diagrams and practicing examples, it finally clicked!
Setting small daily goals helps maintain consistency. 30 minutes of reading + 15 minutes of note-taking works well for me.
CSS Flexbox: display: flex, justify-content (main axis), align-items (cross axis), flex-direction for layout direction.
Git commands: git add . (stage all), git commit -m 'message' (commit), git push origin main (push to remote).
Python list comprehensions: [expression for item in iterable if condition]. More Pythonic than traditional loops.
Build a personal portfolio website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Include projects section, about me, and contact form.
Create a simple todo app with React to practice CRUD operations and state management. Add local storage for persistence.
Python data analysis project: Analyze weather data from a CSV file, create visualizations with matplotlib or seaborn.
